text:
emma: Quick sync — SOC2 milestone sprint: we need to lock owners for audit-log ingestion, KMS key rotation docs, and HSM integration test plan. Targeting milestone cut: 2025-11-10. Who can own each?
raj: I can take audit-log ingestion ownership but need a dependency from eng-infra for the connector certs. Noted the deadline.
lisa: I’ll own KMS key rotation docs + playbook. Will open a PR today (wip). tagging infra for cert ETA @raj.
maria: From product side, we need confirmation that the ingestion meets retention/PII filters — pinging data-privacy for a quick review.
emma: Thanks. raj — can you add a quick checklist in the doc with required fields (timestamp, request_id, principal, action)? makes the auditor happy.
raj: Yep — adding checklist. Also raising a tiny perf question: ingestion max QPS — do we want batching? cc @sre-bot for ops constraints.
sre-bot: Ops note: prefer burstable batching up to 500 qps for behind-the-scenes replay. Will post the perf runbook link.
lisa: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/security/kms-rotation/pull/42 (draft). Added rotation window and KMS + HSM fallback order. Please review.
emma: Ping reviewers: lisa PR needs +1 from security and eng-infra. Can someone please review today? :pray:
maria: I can review security implications later today. small ask: add a sentence about key usage policy for logs vs customer data.
raj: Also opened a tiny config PR for the ingestion lambda: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/audit-ingest/pull/7 — needs infra to approve IAM changes.
lisa: HSM vendor schedule updated — vendor says test certs available 2025-11-03, integration window 11/04-11/08. Marking as soft-blocker for HSM e2e.
emma: Ok add those dates to the milestone doc. We'll call the HSM window a hard dependency for final signoff.
sre-bot: Reminder: we need to capture test evidence artifacts (kafka offsets, sigs) and upload to the audit artifacts bucket: s3://redwood-compliance/soc2/2025Q4/ (use the upload script below)
```
#!/bin/bash
./tools/compliance_upload --env prod --path ./evidence --tag soc2-2025q4
```

emma: Can someone volunteer to run the upload after HSM e2e? small creds will be needed.
raj: I can run it if lisa or infra can confirm the certs are in secrets-manager.
lisa: Will confirm by 11/02 EOD.
maria: I'll coordinate privacy review on 11/05. If anything slips, we should call a short async QA thread.
emma: Thanks everyone — action items:
- raj: ingest + checklist + run upload after certs
- lisa: KMS rotation PR, confirm vendor cert date
- maria: privacy review
- eng-infra: approve IAM + certs
I'll update milestone doc and ping oncall if any blocker emerges. :white_check_mark:
raj: noted, starting checklist now.
